access.notes: Must support B3LYP/6-31G** and CHELPG partial charges. PySCF recommended as a free Python library.
Standard water model; parameters are publicly documented and embedded in many MD packages. No specific download required.
The geometry can be generated using known carbon nanotube coordinates or scripted by the agent; no external pre-made file is strictly required.
